name: Devin CLI, this computer
summary: Hands a bounded task to the Devin CLI on this computer.

workspace_probe.note: The model name is deliberately not a model. The executor checks workspace trust before it validates the model, so this argv exits non-zero either way: on an untrusted workspace it names the declared refusal, and on an accepted one it stops at an unknown-model error that echoes the fake name — the acceptance word. An exit naming neither is unknown, not a route.

refuses.name: untrusted_workspace
refuses.match: Refusing to run in an untrusted workspace
refuses.explanation: The executor declines a directory nobody has trusted interactively. Six of six delegations from a git worktree under /private/tmp were declined this way while the capability was installed, detected, and reporting its version, which is the state a present-or-absent probe cannot report.
